item.title: Verbose beta 250
item.description:
A muted mic doesn't cost you the recording

Mac

  • If your mic is muted while you record, the Mac's built-in mic fills in what it missed. The built-in mic listens beside a USB or other mic and keeps its last 15 seconds. Turn it off in Settings › Recording and transcription › Speakers.
  • A muted mic shows a notification and a menu bar alert when Verbose isn't in front. Verbose also notices mics that send faint noise instead of silence when muted, by comparing them with the built-in mic.

Also on iPhone

  • A muted USB or wired mic moves the recording to the iPhone microphone and tells you.
